description.text: Deck Build Box: Stellar Guidance, released on 18 October 2024: ten packs of the Stellar Guidance expansion and a fixed set of Pokémon, Trainer and basic Energy cards of every type for building decks, among them Mew ex, Pidgeot ex, ACE SPEC cards and Buddy-Buddy Poffin. Some cards differ in look from their first print.
